3. after Verbs of hindering, denying, avoiding, needing , when μὴ οὐ resembles Lat. quin or quominus , οὐδὲν κωλύει μὴ οὐκ ἀληθὲς εἶναι τοῦτο nihil impedit quin hoc verum sit; or with the Art., οὐδὲν ἐλλείψω τὸ μὴ οὐ πυθέσθαι nihil praetermittam quominus reperiam , (Sophocles Tragicus)
